b: In her eightieth year, during her first ever trip to Scotland to close Sonica festival in Glasgow, electronic music pioneer Suzanne Ciani looks back on her career with Claire Sawers. Main portrait: Dan Wilton

From her early days studying classical composition, to her game-changing friendship with the electronic instrument designer Don Buchla, Suzanne Ciani was always interested in world building. Her ability to create vast, echoing dreamscapes or equally impactful sonic miniatures has gained her huge respect and a broad, multi-generational fanbase; one that didn’t exist at the outset, as the technologies she used were initially only known to a handful.
